changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment: Establishments (cơ sở kinh doanh, doanh nghiệp): ENTERPRISE facility type, the "conditional business line" flag (ngành nghề kinh doanh có điều kiện về ANTT; boarding houses are conditional by law) exposed through the tc2_roster.household view as an appended column.

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment: Boarding houses already registered are conditional businesses. Direct table update outside the roster workflow, so the audit trigger needs an actor and reason for this one migration step.

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment: Employees and violation history of an establishment; papers and photos reuse attachment (owner kind FACILITY). Employee identity numbers are stored encrypted with a keyed lookup, like resident identities.
